agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Who works for you, what they did and what waits for your approval.
agents.noPending: Nothing pending. Everything the agents propose shows up here.
agents.managedNote: Runs on Claude Managed Agents with a budget per run.
agents.codeNote: Works without keys: the calendar decides; the AI only resolves conflicts.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Your portfolio at a glance · {count} properties

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Every conversation; what needs a reply comes first.
inbox.handoffOn: You are handling this conversation: the AI stays out.
inbox.windowClosed: More than 24 h since the guest last wrote: WhatsApp only allows approved templates.

properties.title: Properties
properties.subtitle: Flats, buildings and what the AI knows about each.
properties.name: Name
properties.privateHint: The AI never sees it: only a placeholder filled in when sending to a guest during their stay.
properties.importHint: CSV with category,content columns or the flat's PDF manual.
properties.missing: No knowledge yet: add facts or ask Anfi to help you build the house manual.
properties.learnHint: Anfi reads how you've answered your guests and suggests the property facts missing here.
properties.learn_ok: Done: there's a card with what it learned in <link>Agents → Approvals</link>. Review and approve it.
properties.learn_not_enough_history: There are still few conversations you've answered for this property.
properties.learn_no_conversations: This property has no conversations yet.
properties.learn_nothing_new: Nothing new found: your knowledge already covers what you usually answer.
properties.learn_error: Something went wrong while learning. Try again.
properties.sesCodeHint: Assigned by the Ministry when you register the property

reservations.title: Bookings
reservations.subtitle: Every booking, with its source and stay phase.
reservations.icalHint: Paste the .ics link from Airbnb or Booking, or upload the file.

operations.title: Operations
operations.subtitle: Cleaning and maintenance planned from the calendar.
operations.empty: No open tasks. Tap "Plan" to create them from the bookings.

simulator.title: Guest simulator
simulator.subtitle: Write as a guest: it goes through the same flow as WhatsApp.
simulator.answered: The AI answered on its own

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Team, automatic messages, language and integrations.
settings.templatesHint: Approve them once and they go out at the right time (inside WhatsApp's 24 h window).
settings.envHint: Keys are added as environment variables in Vercel, never in the panel.
settings.templatesMoved: Scheduled messages now live in “Guest journey”.
settings.sesHint: Files the guest report through the web service. Use the details of your registration at the Ministry of the Interior e-office (tick web-service filing).
settings.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change connections.
settings.smoobuHint: Imports your properties, bookings and messages from Airbnb, Booking.com and more; Anfi replies through Smoobu. Create the key in Smoobu → Settings → Advanced → API Keys.
settings.mcpTitle: Your AnfitrIA in Claude or ChatGPT
settings.mcpHint: Create a personal key and connect AnfitrIA as an MCP server: ask about your day, availability or an escalation from your assistant. Guest replies arrive here as cards to approve.
settings.keyOnce: Copy the key now: you won't see it again.
settings.keyChatgpt: In ChatGPT or Claude Desktop, add a custom MCP connector with this URL and the key as a Bearer token.
settings.escalationsToHint: If nobody owns the conversation, it's assigned to this person when the AI escalates.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: What the AI decided and what each person did, with the time.

auth.name: Your name
auth.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm the account. Open it, then log in.
auth.tagline: Your supervised AI concierge, with a voice.

assistant.title: Anfi
assistant.subtitle: Your assistant
assistant.placeholder: Ask about your day, a booking or an escalation…
assistant.welcome: Hi! I'm Anfi. Ask me what's on today, which escalations are waiting, or ask me to prepare a reply.
assistant.suggestions: What's on today?|Which escalations are pending?|Give me the app tour
assistant.voiceErr_mic: No microphone access: allow it in the browser.
assistant.voiceErr_openai_auth: OpenAI rejected the key (OPENAI_API_KEY). Check it is valid and has permissions.
assistant.voiceErr_openai_quota: OpenAI out of credit or rate-limited: check billing.
assistant.voiceErr_openai_model: Your OpenAI account has no access to the voice model.
assistant.voiceErr_other: Voice could not start. Try again.
assistant.settingsAnfiLangHint: Automatic: Anfi answers in the language you use.
assistant.settingsNoPreview: This voice can only be heard in a live voice session.
assistant.settingsCustomHint: If set, it replaces the chosen voice in live sessions.
assistant.settingsCustomInvalid: The ID must be 4–64 letters, digits, - or _.
assistant.settingsRestartNote: You're in a call: saving restarts Anfi's voice with the new settings.
assistant.prefilled: Filled in by Anfi: review it and press the button yourself
assistant.askAnfiHint: Talk to Anfi: it fills in what's on this page and you review it
assistant.askPlaceholder: Tell it what to add or fill in here…

journey.title: Guest journey
journey.subtitle: Scheduled messages for every moment of the stay. Only the ones you approve go out.
journey.hint: Hours count from the booking, check-in or check-out, in the property's local time
journey.emptyHint: Create the suggested journey (6 messages, unapproved) and review them one by one.
journey.positiveOnly: Only if the stay went well (no urgent issues)
journey.asVoice: Send as a voice note in Anfi's voice (WhatsApp)

checkin.title: Guest registration
checkin.why: Spanish law (Real Decreto 933/2021) requires every guest to be registered with the Ministry of the Interior. Fill this in once and arrive with no paperwork.
checkin.filed: Your registration has been filed with the Ministry. See you soon!
checkin.alreadyDone: We've received your details. If you need to correct something, you can submit them again.
checkin.privacy: Your details are only used for the mandatory guest registration and are kept for as long as the law requires (3 years).

form.municipalityCodeHint: The official code of your municipality; search “código municipio INE” on
form.kinship: Relationship to an adult in the group
form.sent: Thank you! We've received your registration.
form.locked: This registration has already been filed and can't be changed. Message your host.
form.invalid: Please check the fields marked in red.

docTypes.OTRO: Other ID (e.g. EU national ID card)

registrations.title: Guest registration
registrations.subtitle: The guest report to SES.Hospedajes (required in Spain within 24 h of arrival).
registrations.missingCodes: Missing establishment code for: {names}. Add it on each property's page.
registrations.allSet: SES.Hospedajes connected and every property has its code.
registrations.travellers: {n, plural, =0 {no travellers yet} one {# traveller} other {# travellers}}
registrations.xmlHint: Download the report to check it or upload it by hand
registrations.footnote: The guest fills in their details from the link (Anfi adds it to “Booking confirmed” with '{checkin_link}'). You review and file; the Ministry answers with a communication code. Data is kept for 3 years, as the law requires.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Monthly statement per property, for the owner.
reports.footnote: Stays across two months are split by night. Amounts come from the booking data (PMS or entered by hand).

extras.title: Extras
extras.subtitle: What you can offer your guests: early check-in, late check-out, parking…
extras.how: When a guest asks for something in your catalogue, you get a card with the offer and its price. Approve it and we send it; you collect payment as you always do.
extras.name: Name
extras.keywordsPh: Words that detect it, comma-separated (early check-in, arrive early…)

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: Paste a review and Anfi drafts the public reply, in your tone and with the property's facts.
reviews.hint: Negative reviews get a calm, specific reply; missing facts show as [CHECK: …] for you to fill in.

welcome.title: Welcome to AnfitrIA, {name}!
welcome.body: I’m Anfi, your co-host. Shall I show you around in two minutes? I’ll tell you what each part does and where to set it all up.
welcome.point_one: Where to add your property and bookings
welcome.point_two: How I answer your guests (and when I ask you)
welcome.point_three: How to ask me for things by voice
